name: Secret Boundary
display_title: Bump the python-deps group across 2 directories with 18 updates

head_commit.message:
Bump the python-deps group across 2 directories with 18 updates

Updates the requirements on [aws-cdk-lib](https://github.com/aws/aws-cdk), [boto3](https://github.com/boto/boto3), [botocore](https://github.com/boto/botocore), [pytest](https://github.com/pytest-dev/pytest), [pydantic](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic), [claude-agent-sdk](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-agent-sdk-python), [mcp](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/python-sdk), [bedrock-agentcore](https://github.com/aws/bedrock-agentcore-sdk-python), [aws-opentelemetry-distro](https://github.com/aws-observability/aws-otel-python-instrumentation), [pyjwt](https://github.com/jpadilla/pyjwt), [strands-agents](https://github.com/strands-agents/harness-sdk), [langchain](https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchain), [langgraph](https://github.com/langchain-ai/langgraph), [langgraph-prebuilt](https://github.com/langchain-ai/langgraph), [langchain-aws](https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchain-aws), [langgraph-checkpoint-aws](https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchain-aws), [urllib3](https://github.com/urllib3/urllib3) and [python-multipart](https://github.com/Kludex/python-multipart) to permit the latest version.
